decisions.decision: The Eagle House will not be used as an emergency site because it would cost too much to rehab the building to make it suitable.
decisions.quote: it was decided that the eagle house will not be used as an emergency site because it would cost too much to rehab the building to make it suitable

decisions.decision: No generator will be included in the FY14 Capital Plan; a smaller generator to keep the sprinkler system from tripping will be submitted to the next Capital Plan Request cycle.
decisions.quote: there will be no generator included in the fy14 capital plan. the dpw director needs to get an electrical contractor in for quotes

decisions.decision: Ms. Noble will contact Ms. Lacka to set an orientation date after her appointment by the Board of Selectmen; the COA Chair and Vice Chair will also attend.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will contact ms. lacka to set a date for orientation after she is appointed by the board of selectmen.

decisions.decision: Ms. Noble will prepare a new COA Organizational Chart, requested by the board, for presentation at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will be working on a new coa organizational chart, which was requested by the board, to be presented at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: The COA Chairperson will email Town Manager Kerry Speidel to invite her to the February 12 COA meeting.
decisions.quote: the chairperson of the coa will email the town manager, kerry speidel, to invite her to the next coa meeting to be held on february 12

decisions.decision: Ms. Noble will investigate having Monty Tech students do the Eagle House stairway between the upper and lower parking lots as a project.
decisions.quote: ms. noble is investigating working with monty tech to have the students do this as a project.

decisions.decision: Barbara Brown will bring Bylaw changes to the board for review and approval at the February COA meeting.
decisions.quote: barbara brown informed the board that she will be bringing bylaw changes to the board for review and approval at the february coa meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Price for all meals remains a $2.25 donation under the new kitchen schedule.
budget_items.quote: price will remain the same for all meals as $2.25 donation.

budget_items.topic: COA Gift Account for food purchases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director hopes to use the COA Gift Account at Town Hall to buy food for the Monday and Tuesday on-site meals.
budget_items.quote: the director hopes to use the coa gift account, which is accessed through town hall, to purchase the food

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA received a cut last year; the FY14 targeted budget calls for restoring part of it.
budget_items.quote: last year the council on aging received a $12k cut. in fy14 the targeted budget calls for $6900 to be restored to the coa budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Donations received in July are held in a Gift Account at Town Hall and proposed to offset meal site food service.
budget_items.quote: the $5k in donations that was received in july for the coa is in a gift account at town hall.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Energy subsidy vendor lines changed: TransCanada line closed, Direct Energy moved to electric, and Santa Buckley Energy added for gas, with remaining TransCanada funds moved to Santa Buckley.
budget_items.quote: a new vendor, santa buckley energy has been brought on to subsidize national grid in the gas line.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Lunenburg Friendly Seniors sent a donation to the Eagle House Supporters.
budget_items.quote: the lunenburg friendly seniors sent a donation of $300 to the eagle house supporters.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Lunenburg Cultural Council made $200 available to the senior center for a music program.
budget_items.quote: $200 has been made available to the senior center for a two part music program

budget_items.topic: Generator and Eagle House rehab cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rehabbing the Eagle House to serve as an emergency site was judged too costly; no generator in FY14 Capital Plan.
budget_items.quote: it would cost too much to rehab the building to make it suitable

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director is processing mileage reimbursements to Meals on Wheels drivers.
budget_items.quote: ms. noble informed the board that she is currently working on processing meals on wheels mileage

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Eagle Heights project is on hold awaiting government/state funding.
budget_items.quote: this project has been held up waiting for funding from government/state agencies.
